Which neighbourhoods are actually safe?

Wandroz shows travellers city neighbourhoods on a real interactive map, using official public data where it exists — not just online reviews.

This is an early data prototype, not a finished product. Pick a city below to open its map — click any neighbourhood for the level, the reasoning, and a Booking.com link for that area.
